My advice to you would be to:

Try not to stress.

So I was trying REALLY hard to get pregnant (no dice) until I spoke with my doctor and was actually pregnant the next month after that. Here is the advice that he gave me: 1) get an ovulation kit (if you have a typical cycle of 28 days you should start checking around 10-14 days after the first day of your last period. 2) DO NOT have sex every day when you are likely ovulating. This depletes the man's sperm count. He recommended not having sex for 2-3 days before ovulation.

One last thing in terms of the ovulation kit. This will help you determine if you are actually ovulating, so if you test for a few months between like 10-20 days after the first day of your period and you don't get any positives, this is something you may want to bring up with your doctor. I have PCOS and wasn't even sure if I was ovulating, so the kit really helped ease my fears a bit. Good luck!
